output_text: description: Definitive guidelines for building secure, performant, maintainable apps on Cloudflare (tiny bundles, edge-first design, robust security). Prioritize Workers & Pages. Use the official `wrangler` CLI for project scaffolding and deployment. ✅ GOOD: Always start with `wrangler generate`. npx wrangler generate my-worker --type=module --ts; npx create-cloudflare@latest my-fullstack-app --framework next. Monorepos: use `pnpm` or `yarn workspaces`. ✅ GOOD: Centralize dependencies/build scripts. `"workspaces": ["apps/*", "packages/*"]`. Environment Variables: manage secrets via `wrangler.toml` or Cloudflare dashboard. Use `.dev.vars` for local dev. ❌ BAD: Storing sensitive data directly in code or `.env` files that aren’t `.dev.vars`. ✅ GOOD: Define in `wrangler.toml` and reference in Worker. name = "my-worker"; main = "src/index.ts"; MY_API_KEY = "yo
